items.source: The Streamable HTTP transport allows MCP servers to operate as independent processes that can handle multiple client connections using HTTP POST and GET requests, with optional Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming for multiple server messages. It replaces the SSE transport.
items.translation: Streamable HTTP transport 允许 MCP 服务器作为独立进程运行，能够通过 HTTP POST 和 GET 请求处理多个客户端连接，并可选择性地使用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 流式传输来发送多条服务器消息。它取代了 SSE transport。
